gloss: communicating in writing; conversation by writing

definitions.explanation: Talking with someone by writing notes back and forth instead of speaking, for example with a deaf or hard-of-hearing person, when one has lost one's voice, or between Japanese and Chinese speakers who share kanji.

examples.japanese: {筆談|ひつだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆談|ひつだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the counter we can also communicate in writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とき、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|つう}じなかった→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{筆談|ひつだん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I traveled in China and couldn't make myself understood, I communicated by writing kanji.

notes:
{筆|ひつ} (brush, writing) + {談|だん} (talk).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆談|ひつだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to communicate in writing
- {筆談|ひつだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to get something across in writing
- {筆談|ひつだん}ボード / {筆談器|ひつだんき}: a writing board kept at counters for written conversation
- {筆談|ひつだん}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: "written communication available" (a sign at service counters)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手話|しゅわ}: sign language — the other main way of talking with deaf people
